description: [Residential] Find targeting codes. Without filters it returns countries. Add country to get its regions, cities and ISPs; add region or city to narrow cities and ISPs. Use the returned codes in residential_create_connections.

country.description: Two-letter country code in upper case, for example US.

region.description: Numeric region code returned for the country.
